# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Key Observations
- **Champion retained**: v5_latest holds position due to better tuning stability and lower drawdown
- **Candidate strength**: `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` showed improved lockbox minimum (1.35 vs 1.13) — better tail risk
- **Candidate weakness**: Higher worst-case drawdown (-11.2%) and poor tuning minimum (0.05) indicate overfitting risk

## Ready to Execute
```bash
# 1. Run AUB module experiments with auto-selection
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidate experiments  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate next-fix analysis report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Recommendation
Proceed with the three commands in sequence. The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` architecture shows promise on lockbox robustness — consider variants that constrain drawdown while preserving the improved tail behavior.
